services.name: Lost Report
services.description: File a report for any lost item such as mobile phone, wallet, documents, keys, purse, ID card, or any personal belonging. Get a police acknowledgment for lost items.
services.description_hi: खोई हुई किसी भी वस्तु जैसे मोबाइल फोन, पर्स, दस्तावेज़, चाबियां, आधार कार्ड के लिए रिपोर्ट दर्ज करें। खोई वस्तुओं के लिए पुलिस पावती प्राप्त करें।
steps: Access the Delhi Police Lost & Found portal and select "Lost Article Report" → click "Register"
Enter personal info: Complainant Name, Parent's Name, Address and Email ID
Fill event details: Place of Loss, Date of Loss and Time of Loss (must be within Delhi)
Choose item type from the "Lost Articles" dropdown, add description / serial number and click "ADD". Repeat for multiple items
Solve the alphanumeric CAPTCHA and click "Submit"
A "Record Saved Successfully" confirmation appears. A digitally verifiable PDF is generated, downloaded to your device and emailed to you
steps_found: Select "Found Article Report" on the main menu and click "Register"
Input your Mobile Number and click "Send" to trigger a verification code
Enter the OTP and click "Verify" to unlock the reporting ledger
Select the article category and enter its serial number to query the central database for any matching lost report
If no match is found: fill the description fields, upload an image of the found article and click "Submit" to store it in the central registry for future matching
services.notes: Lost Reports are purely informational records (for re-issuing SIM cards, identity documents, etc.) and skip police station investigations entirely. Retrieve past reports anytime using your LR Number and registered Email ID.

questions.text: Are you reporting an item you have lost, or recording an unclaimed article you have found?
Does your lost item involve any suspicion of theft, break-in, or snatched property?

rules: If 'Report Found Article' is selected, show the Found steps.

If 'Yes' to crime (suspicion of theft/break-in/snatching), explain that they must file an e-FIR rather than a Lost Report, and direct them to the Theft e-FIR portal (https://propertytheft.delhipolice.gov.in/).
If 'No' to crime, show the Lost steps and notes.

services.name: MV Theft E FIR
services.description: File an online e-FIR for motor vehicle theft. Use this if your car, bike, scooter, or any vehicle has been stolen.
services.description_hi: मोटर वाहन चोरी के लिए ऑनलाइन e-FIR दर्ज करें। यदि आपकी कार, बाइक, स्कूटर या कोई भी वाहन चोरी हो गया है तो इसका उपयोग करें।
documents: Complainant ID Proof — Aadhaar Card, Passport, PAN Card, Driving Licence, or Election ID; PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB
Property Details — list of personal items left inside the vehicle (laptops, wallets, baggage) for the secondary theft itemizer
steps: Open the Delhi Police MV Theft portal
Click "NEW USER" and register with Name, Email and Mobile Number
Enter the 4-digit OTP sent to your device (valid for 2 hours)
On your dashboard, click the "Register FIR" tile
Step A — Complainant Details: enter name, address, time window, and the exact Delhi location of the theft
Step B — Vehicle Details: enter Registration Number; Engine No., Chassis No., Make, Model and Colour are auto-populated from the national vehicle registry
Step C — Property Stolen: use the "+" button to append personal items stolen from inside the vehicle
Step D — Other Details: upload your ID proof and describe any suspected individuals if known
Review the PREVIEW draft, click "Submit", and tick the ROAC checkbox to authorise registration
Download your digitally signed FIR. Your case is routed to an Investigating Officer; alerts are sent to NCRB, SCRB and State Transport Authorities
steps_no_reg: Open the Delhi Police MV Theft portal
Click "NEW USER" and register with Name, Email and Mobile Number
Enter the 4-digit OTP sent to your device (valid for 2 hours)
On your dashboard, click the "Register FIR" tile
Step A — Complainant Details: enter name, address, time window, and the exact Delhi location of the theft
Step B — Vehicle Details: manually enter Engine Number, Chassis Number, Make, Model and Colour as available
Step C — Property Stolen: use the "+" button to append personal items stolen from inside the vehicle
Step D — Other Details: upload your ID proof and describe any suspected individuals if known
Review the PREVIEW draft, click "Submit", and tick the ROAC checkbox to authorise registration
Download your digitally signed FIR. Your case is routed to an Investigating Officer; alerts are sent to NCRB, SCRB and State Transport Authorities
services.notes: Your application enters 'Pending Investigation' status. If untraced, the system automatically compiles and forwards the Section 173 CrPC final report to the eCourt on the 21st day. Once approved by the Judge, insurance companies can pull this digital order directly using your FIR number and year for instant claim settlements.

questions.text: Was your motor vehicle stolen within the territorial jurisdiction of Delhi?
Are you registering as the Citizen / Complainant, or as a Police official logging a station report?
Do you have the vehicle's permanent Registration Number available?
options: Yes — I have the Reg No.

rules: If 'No' to stolen in Delhi, explain that online registration is strictly restricted to thefts occurring within Delhi. The user must report the incident to their local jurisdiction police station.

If 'Duty Officer / Police Official' is selected, explain that the Duty Officer portal requires station-level authentication. Direct them to the official MV Theft portal to log in with their official credentials.
If 'Yes' to registration number, explain that the registry will auto-populate vehicle details, and use the steps with registration number.
If 'No' to registration number, explain they must manually enter Engine Number, Chassis Number, Make, Model, and Colour, and use the steps without registration number.

Photo Identity Proof / Registration Certificate — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB (PAN Card, Driving Licence, Election ID, or Aadhaar Card)
Residential Address Proof — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB (Aadhaar, Bank Passbook, Driving Licence, Election ID, Passport, Electricity Bill, Telephone Bill, Ration Card, or Rent Agreement)
Forwarding Letter from Govt / PSU / Semi-Govt / Others — PDF / JPEG / JPG / PNG, under 200 KB
steps: Open the PCC & CVR portal
Register: enter name, mobile, email, password and captcha
Receive and enter the OTP
Log in
Click "Apply New"
Select Individual or Organisation
Select the PCC type and verification mode
Fill your present address; add up to 5 previous Delhi addresses if applicable
Fill criminal case details if any (up to 10 cases; multiple states allowed)
Upload the 4 documents listed above
Review the form preview and edit if needed

Which verification mode do you need?

services.description: Search database of unidentified persons found in Delhi. If a missing family member may have been found but not yet identified, search here.
services.description_hi: दिल्ली में पाए गए अज्ञात व्यक्तियों का डेटाबेस खोजें। यदि लापता परिवार का सदस्य मिल गया हो लेकिन पहचाना न गया हो।

services.name: Unclaimed/ Seized Vehicle Search
services.description: Search for unclaimed or seized vehicles in Delhi Police custody. Check if your vehicle has been towed or seized.
keywords: police ne gaadi pakad li search
services.description_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस की हिरासत में जब्त या अनावश्यक वाहन खोजें। जांचें कि आपका वाहन टो या जब्त हुआ है या नहीं।

services.name: View Complaint Status
services.description: Check and track the current status of your complaint filed with Delhi Police. See if your complaint is being processed.
services.description_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस में दर्ज की गई अपनी शिकायत की वर्तमान स्थिति जांचें और ट्रैक करें।

services.name: View FIR
services.description: View or download a copy of your FIR (First Information Report) filed with Delhi Police.
services.description_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस में दर्ज की गई अपनी FIR (प्रथम सूचना रिपोर्ट) देखें या डाउनलोड करें।

services.name: ZIP NET
services.description: ZIPNET is Delhi Police's integrated database for searching stolen vehicles, missing mobiles, missing persons, unidentified bodies, and seized vehicles.
services.description_hi: ZIPNET दिल्ली पुलिस का एकीकृत डेटाबेस है — चोरी वाहन, खोया मोबाइल, लापता व्यक्ति, अज्ञात शव और जब्त वाहन यहाँ खोजें।

services.name: SPUWAC - Special Police Unit for Women and Children
services.description: The Delhi Police SPUWAC portal is a specialized digital gateway offering emergency assistance, complaint lodging, mediation, and self-defense training to protect women, children, and senior citizens.
keywords: Sexual Harassment in Public, Private or Workplace

services.description_hi: दिल्ली पुलिस का SPUWAC पोर्टल एक विशेष डिजिटल गेटवे है, जो महिलाओं, बच्चों और वरिष्ठ नागरिकों की सुरक्षा के लिए आपातकालीन सहायता, शिकायत दर्ज करने, मध्यस्थता और आत्मरक्षा प्रशिक्षण जैसी सेवाएं प्रदान करता है।
